story.title: COLD HEARTH
story.logline: A mining militia trailing a few ash-cloud raiders finds someone is selling the convoy schedules.
antagonists: Syndic Maro Quill, Cinderfall Ore Syndicate

lines.speaker: Marshal Odessa Brant
lines.text: Three beacons, one slow orbit. Your first patrol should be dull enough to bore a rock.

lines.speaker: Ivo Calder
lines.text: Somebody has been scraping our beacons for data. If you meet them, find out what they wanted.

lines.speaker: Pilot Tam Reyes
lines.text: Where were they last seen, Calder? I'd like to know when to stop admiring the ash.

lines.speaker: Ivo Calder
lines.text: Near NAV 2. They know our route as well as we do.

lines.speaker: Marshal Odessa Brant
lines.text: I'll hold the station. Bring the raiders' log home if you can.

lines.speaker: Pilot Tam Reyes
lines.text: Understood. I'll keep my wing close.

briefing.speaker: Marshal Odessa Brant, Hearth Station
text: Welcome to Hearth Station, pilot. The militia is small, so everyone flies and nobody gets a speech.
For a month raiders have been sniffing around the outer beacons, counting who comes and goes.
Fly the three-beacon patrol. If the raiders show, make sure none of them leaves. Then come home.

steps.caption: You launch from Hearth Station, the militia's anchor in the Reach.
Fly the patrol route: NAV 1, NAV 2 and NAV 3, in that order.
Raiders were seen hiding in the ash near NAV 2. Expect three Jackals.
When the route is clear, return to Hearth Station.

intel: Hostile: 3x Jackal raider (light, fast, lightly armed)
Craft: Kite patrol craft, twin lasers

debrief.win: Three raiders down and the beacons hold. The Ashmaw now know we are watching.
debrief.lose: We lost you out in the ash. The raiders will know exactly how thin our patrols are.

dialogue.speaker: Marshal Odessa Brant
dialogue.text: The raider log lists our hauler schedule. Down to the hour. That did not come from a scan.

dialogue.speaker: Pilot Tam Reyes
dialogue.text: Then warn the Cinder before we hunt the leak. Is the quartermaster on the line?

lines.speaker: Quartermaster Pell Ostrander
lines.text: Ostrander, supply. The Cinder carries every ounce of ore we trade this quarter, and her departure was moved without my say.

lines.speaker: Pilot Tam Reyes
lines.text: Can she go faster, Quartermaster? One hauler is easier to cover if she keeps pace with us.

lines.speaker: Quartermaster Pell Ostrander
lines.text: She's loaded to the rails. You fly to her speed, not the other way round.

lines.speaker: Marshal Odessa Brant
lines.text: Get her to Reach Relay first. We can find out who moved the schedule once she is alive to be asked.

lines.speaker: Pilot Tam Reyes
lines.text: Understood. Kite 3 stays with the hauler if they try to draw us off.

briefing.speaker: Marshal Odessa Brant, Hearth Station
text: The Cinder is hauling the quarter's ore to Reach Relay. Escort her through the lane.
The lane is long and open, and the raiders have the schedule. Fly escort with Kite 3.
Pickets will test you first. The real strike comes across the lane for the hauler.

steps.caption: The ore hauler Cinder starts here, bound for Reach Relay.
Reach Relay, almost four kilometres down the lane. Past it the militia can cover her.
Expect pickets from the flank, then a strike group going for the hauler.

intel: Hostile: Jackal raiders in two groups

debrief.win: The Cinder docked at the Relay. The Reach eats and trades this quarter.
debrief.lose: We lost the ore the Reach cannot replace.

dialogue.speaker: Quartermaster Pell Ostrander
dialogue.text: You saved the quarter. The raiders flew straight for her, as if they had the lane map on their dash.
